title: Original library event lane scheduling fixture

provenance.source: Original authored English, no user transcript or audio

brief.topic: Ravi and Meena lend library books from two labeled boxes. Ravi has blue Aster with twelve books; Meena has red Cedar with nine.
brief.register: Neutral everyday spoken Telugu; polite audience address మీరు.

glossary.note: Name of Ravi’s blue book box
Name of Meena’s red book box

brief.numbers: Retain exact numbers and uncertainty; speak them in Telugu.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi and Meena are preparing a small library event.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi keeps the blue box, and Meena keeps the red one.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: The blue box is called Aster; the red box is called Cedar.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Aster contains twelve books, while Cedar contains nine.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Neither box contains books that are for sale.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi thinks his box may need a stronger handle.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: He will replace it only if the old one breaks.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena does not need to replace the handle on hers.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Their event starts at ten, not at eleven.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Visitors may borrow a book, but they cannot keep it forever.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena wrote the return date on a yellow card.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: She put that card inside Cedar before closing the lid.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: It must stay there until the first visitor arrives.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi put a different card inside Aster.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: His card lists the twelve titles, not their prices.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Three of those books have large print.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: The other nine use ordinary print.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: He reserved the large print books for visitors who requested them.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: They are not available to everyone yet.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena has not reserved any books from her box.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: One visitor asked whether Cedar contained a dictionary.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: She said it contained two, but neither was new.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Both dictionaries can still be borrowed.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: The visitor chose the smaller one and thanked Meena.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: He did not take the larger one as well.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi recorded that choice in the shared notebook.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: The notebook belongs to the library, not to either volunteer.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: It cost two hundred and fifty rupees, including delivery.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: A replacement cover might cost another fifty rupees.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena has not ordered that cover yet.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: So the final cost is not confirmed.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi will check the old cover before buying a new one.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: If it can be repaired, they will keep it.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: That decision does not affect the return dates.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: A parent asked for one extra day to return a book.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena agreed for that parent, but not for every visitor.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: The exception applies only to that borrowed book.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: All the other books are still due on Friday.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi wrote the exception beside the title in the notebook.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: He did not change the date on every card.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: By noon, Aster had five books left and Cedar had four.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena checked both counts before announcing them.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: She said those numbers described books still in the boxes.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: They did not describe the total number of visitors.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Two visitors had only looked around and borrowed nothing.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi thanked them too, because attendance did not require borrowing.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: The volunteers might repeat the event next month.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: They will decide after the borrowed books come back.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Until then, another event is only a possibility.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Neither volunteer has promised a date.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Meena will keep Cedar at the library until Friday.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: Ravi will bring Aster back tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: He must return the blue box, even if it is empty.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.text: She will check both boxes again before closing the library.

semantic_expectations.check: Ravi owns blue Aster/12 books; Meena red Cedar/9. Only his handle may need replacement, conditional on breaking.
The yellow return-date card stays in Cedar until first visitor. Ravi has a different title-list card, not prices.
Three large-print books reserved only for requesting visitors; other nine ordinary. Not available to everyone yet. Meena has no reservations.
Cedar has two non-new dictionaries. Visitor took smaller only, not both.
250 includes delivery; possible extra50 cover un-ordered; finalcost unconfirmed; retain old cover if repairable.
One parent/book gets one extra day; all others due Friday. Not blanket date change.
Aster five/Cedar four left are remaining books, not visitor totals; two visitors borrowed nothing.
Next-month repeat possible only; decision after returns, no promised date.
Meena keeps red Cedar until Friday; Ravi returns blue Aster tomorrow even empty. She later checks both.
